# Aegis

> Personal archetype and mental health platform: mood tracking, decision journaling, habit coaching, and AI-guided insights.

Aegis helps individuals discover their personal archetype and build a
sustained practice around mood, decisions, habits and relationships,
supported by AI-generated coaching insights.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Introduction to the Aegis platform.
- [Sign in](/auth): Access an existing Aegis account.
- [Newsletter](/newsletter): Public editions on archetypes, mental
  fitness and leadership.
